description: Na₄ScSnSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.87 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.98 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.64 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.22 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Sc, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Sc, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Sn, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramid. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Sn, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃SiSn trigonal bipyramid.
